event: Band formed by five friends in Dayton, Ohio.
MySpace profile 'Lets Get It' created ('Member since 6/4/2008').
Earliest archived show listings on the band's MySpace (Aug 8 onward); label field reads 'Unsigned'.
Announced dates with Brokencyde ('The Get Money Tour') across the Southwest and Plains.
Dates with Punchline and The Years Gone By in the Northeast (fan-submitted listings).
Dates on a bill with Watchout! There's Ghosts across the South and East (fan-submitted, some also on the band's own schedule).
Signed to Fearless Records 'just after the band's one-year anniversary' (about a year after forming; exact date not stated).
'All My Life' appears on the Rockin' Romance compilation (Destiny Worldwide Records).
Digital Spaces EP streams exclusively on PureVolume ahead of release.
Opens for Jeffree Star at The Social, Orlando.
Announced west-coast/Midwest dates with Jeffree Star, Artist vs Poet and Watchout! Theres Ghosts.
Digital Spaces EP released on Fearless Records.
'Do Not Disturb (Tell Me How Bad)' appears on the Japanese compilation Beyond [The] Blue Vol. 3.
Atticus Metal Tour dates with Finch, blessthefall, Drop Dead, Gorgeous and Vanna (fan-submitted listings).
No Checkpoints in the Jungle Tour with Breathe Carolina (fan-submitted listings).
Dates with VersaEmerge and I See Stars (fan-submitted listings).
Listed in the Bamboozle 2010 lineup, East Rutherford, NJ.
Press release: band to record its debut album in Hollywood, CA in late August 2010 with Ian Kirkpatrick and Mike Green.
Band-channel video 'Our A&R Nate wrestling with Chris' published.
Fall dates on a bill with Blood On the Dance Floor and Breathe Electric (fan-submitted listings).
Band-channel video 'Down To Us ('Tis The Season To Be Fearless)' published.
'We Don't Care' video and free download released ahead of the album.
'Eyes On Me' video published on the band's channel.
Masters of the Universe released on Fearless Records.
Under the Gun Review publishes a review of Masters of the Universe (8.8/10).
Listed on the Unsilent Night 4 festival lineup, Dallas (fan-submitted listing; lineups conflict).
Active period ends (per MusicBrainz).
Last dated upload on the band's channel: 'All My Life Cover (Studio Video feat. David Marsh)'.
Original domain letsgetitband.com expires and is parked; later parked for sale (2014).
